# Xbox Game Pass
> Subscription service from Xbox for playing hundreds of PC, console, and cloud-enabled games for a monthly fee.

Xbox Game Pass lets players discover, install, and stream games across console, PC, and supported devices. The site includes plan details, game catalog browsing, membership information, support resources, and Xbox ecosystem links.

## Membership Plans
- [Xbox Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass): Main overview of Game Pass plans, benefits, and featured games.
- [Xbox Game Pass Ultimate](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/ultimate): Details on Ultimate plan benefits including cloud gaming and online multiplayer.
- [PC Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/pc-game-pass): Plan page for PC Game Pass features, pricing, and included titles.
- [Compare Game Pass Plans](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/compare-plans): Side-by-side comparison of available Game Pass membership options.
- [Xbox Game Pass Friends & Family](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/friends-and-family): Information about shared membership offerings where available.

## Game Discovery
- [Browse the Game Pass Catalog](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/games): Search and browse games currently available with Game Pass.
- [Recently Added Games](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/games#recently-added): Highlights newly added titles in the Game Pass catalog.
- [Leaving Soon](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/games#leaving-soon): Shows games scheduled to leave the Game Pass library soon.
- [EA Play with Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/ea-play): Explains EA Play benefits included with eligible Game Pass plans.
- [Cloud Gaming Catalog](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/play): Browse games available to stream through Xbox Cloud Gaming.

## How to Play
- [Xbox Cloud Gaming](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/play): Stream supported games on browser-enabled devices without local installation.
- [Xbox App for Windows](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/apps/xbox-app-for-pc): Download the Xbox app to install and manage PC Game Pass titles.
- [Xbox App Mobile](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/apps/xbox-app-for-mobile): Use the mobile app to browse games, manage installs, and stay connected.
- [Remote Play](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/consoles/remote-play): Stream installed console games from your Xbox to supported devices.
- [Supported Devices](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/cloud-gaming): Overview of devices and requirements for cloud gaming access.

## Games and Benefits
- [Game Pass Quests and Rewards](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/quests): Learn about quests and reward opportunities for members.
- [Member Discounts and Deals](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/member-discounts): Information on purchase discounts available to Game Pass members.
- [Perks](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/perks): Explore partner offers and in-game extras included with membership.
- [Day One Releases](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass#day-one-releases): Overview of games launching into Game Pass on release day.
- [Riot Games Benefits](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass/riot-games): Details on linked-account benefits for Riot titles.

## Account and Subscription
- [Redeem a Code](https://redeem.microsoft.com/): Redeem Game Pass and Xbox digital codes on your Microsoft account.
- [Microsoft Account](https://account.microsoft.com/): Manage billing, subscriptions, and account settings for Xbox services.
- [Services & Subscriptions](https://account.microsoft.com/services): View and manage active Game Pass and Microsoft subscriptions.
- [Xbox Support: Manage Subscription](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/subscriptions-billing/manage-subscriptions/xbox-game-pass-faq): FAQ for managing Game Pass billing and membership changes.
- [Gift Xbox Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/xbox-game-pass-ultimate/cfq7ttc0khs0): Purchase Game Pass Ultimate as a digital gift.

## Support
- [Xbox Support Home](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/): Main support portal for Xbox hardware, services, and subscriptions.
- [Xbox Game Pass FAQ](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/subscriptions-billing/manage-subscriptions/xbox-game-pass-faq): Answers to common questions about Game Pass plans and billing.
- [Cloud Gaming Support](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/games-apps/cloud-gaming/about-cloud-gaming): Help articles for setup, requirements, and troubleshooting cloud gaming.
- [PC Game Pass Support](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/subscriptions-billing/manage-subscriptions/pc-game-pass-faq): FAQ and troubleshooting information for PC Game Pass.
- [Xbox Status](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-live-status): Service status page for Xbox network and related services.

## Xbox Ecosystem
- [Xbox Consoles](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/consoles): Overview of Xbox console hardware and platform features.
- [Xbox Games](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games): Browse Xbox games across console, PC, and cloud.
- [Xbox Accessories](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/accessories): Explore controllers, headsets, and other Xbox accessories.
- [Xbox All Access](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-all-access): Financing program that can include console hardware and Game Pass Ultimate.
- [Xbox Family Settings](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/apps/family-settings-app): Family safety and account management tools for Xbox households.

## News and Updates
- [Xbox Wire](https://news.xbox.com/en-us/): Official Xbox news hub for announcements, releases, and updates.
- [Game Pass News on Xbox Wire](https://news.xbox.com/en-us/tag/xbox-game-pass/): Official posts specifically covering Game Pass additions and announcements.
- [Xbox Wire Gaming](https://news.xbox.com/en-us/category/gaming/): Broader Xbox gaming news, feature stories, and release coverage.
- [Xbox on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@xbox): Official video channel with trailers, updates, and Game Pass announcements.
- [Xbox on X](https://x.com/Xbox): Official Xbox social account for product news and updates.
